title.zh: 列出一次就是已定的同一

statement.zh: 一个列表恰在其成员之间同一已定时能列出一次，按成员的和与计数于是唯一；否证之律不需要它，求和与计数之律只把它作为局部条件。
statement.en: A list can be listed once exactly where identity among its members is decided, and sums and counts once per member are then one number; laws refuting something need nothing, and laws that sum or count need it only as a local condition.

claim.zh: 一个列表的成员之间同一已定（IdentityDecided l），指其中任何两个成员相同或不同已定。s 把 l 列出一次（ListsOnce s l），指 s 不重复（Distinct）且与 l 成员相同。不重复的列表决定其成员之间的同一（Distinct.identityDecided）；成员之间同一已定时，有一个与之成员相同的不重复列表（listsOnce_of_decided，构造性地由 listOnce 给出）；所以列表恰在成员之间同一已定时能列出一次（listsOnce_iff_decided），而它能列出一次从不能被否证（not_not_listsOnce）。成员相同的不重复列表有同样的每个量的总和与同样的长度（total_eq_of_same、ListsOnce.total_eq、ListsOnce.length_eq）；列表所含关系项的数目（Numbers）唯一（Numbers.unique），恰在成员之间同一已定时存在（numbers_iff_decided）；重复只会增加（Numbers.le_length、ListsOnce.total_le）。处处列出一次时否证某事的律，对该列表不加前提地否证它（not_of_listsOnce）；所以结论是否证的律对任何列出方式的家族成立（Flow.Dissipative.opens_listing、Flow.Dissipative.finite_taking_not_recurring_listing、Flow.taking_draws_in_listing、Web.embodiedArising_not_recurring_listing、Flow.taking_not_recurring_listing），在平衡、耗散且生起体现的条件下，每个可枚举世界的生起与止息都不复现（World.Enumerated、World.Enumerated.not_recurring）。用到这一承诺之处它是局部的：一步被封闭（或围绕一个家族被封闭）恰在有一个跨此步封闭、成员之间同一已定的家族时（Flow.enclosed_iff、Flow.around_iff）；世界有限恰在可枚举且关系项之间同一已定时（World.finite_iff）；耗散就是每个封闭家族按成员读一次时的耗散（Flow.dissipative_iff）；每个普查决定其所列者之间的同一（Listed.identityDecided），任何带同一判定的列出给出普查（Listed.of_listing）。重复并非无害：在 Doubled 中流平衡并耗散，把来到停息的条件列两次的家族是封闭的而没有在其上耗散，其存量不降，列一次则降（Doubled.needs_once）。不加前提。读在流的步上：参与一步者恰在其间同一已定时能列出一次并有数目（listsOnce_iff_decided、numbers_iff_decided）；一步把同一关系项列两次，则在两处只数得一个关系项（Flow.present_repeated）；一个类型上的每个流都把每一步列出一次，恰当该类型上的同一已定（Flow.present_listsOnce_all_iff）。清点归入此类的其余 22 条律在 Becoming.ListingRefutations 中以同样方式证明，不需 Distinct（Flow.fed_from_beyond_listing、Web.embodiedArising_fed_from_beyond_listing、Flow.More.opens_listing、Web.embodiedArising_opens_listing、Flow.taking_draws_in_from_listing、Web.embodiedArising_draws_in_listing、Flow.rising_not_recurring_listing、Flow.taking_needs_refinement_listing、Flow.boundary_crossed_listing、Flow.region_not_a_cut_listing 等），因为从外供给与区域边界作为割都是成员的事（Flow.FedFromBeyond.of_within、Flow.cut_of_same）；规律陈述在类型上取同一已定（[DecidableEq]）的 7 条保留它，其余 15 条不需。
claim.en: Identity among a list's members is decided (IdentityDecided l) where for any two members it is decided whether they are the same. s lists l once (ListsOnce s l) where s is without repetition (Distinct) and has the members of l. A list without repetition decides identity among its members (Distinct.identityDecided); where identity among a list's members is decided, some list without repetition has exactly its members (listsOnce_of_decided, constructively by listOnce); so a list can be listed once exactly where identity among its members is decided (listsOnce_iff_decided), and that it can be is never refuted (not_not_listsOnce). Lists without repetition with the same members have the same total of every quantity and the same length (total_eq_of_same, ListsOnce.total_eq, ListsOnce.length_eq); the number of relata a list holds (Numbers) is one number (Numbers.unique) and exists exactly where identity among its members is decided (numbers_iff_decided); repetition only adds (Numbers.le_length, ListsOnce.total_le). A law refuting something wherever a list is listed once refutes it of the list with no premise (not_of_listsOnce); so the laws whose conclusion is a refutation hold of every family however listed (Flow.Dissipative.opens_listing, Flow.Dissipative.finite_taking_not_recurring_listing, Flow.taking_draws_in_listing, Web.embodiedArising_not_recurring_listing, Flow.taking_not_recurring_listing), and under balance, dissipation and embodied arising, neither arising nor ceasing recurs in an enumerated world (World.Enumerated, World.Enumerated.not_recurring). Where the commitment is used it is local: a step is enclosed, or enclosed around a family, exactly where some family closed across it has decided identity among its members (Flow.enclosed_iff, Flow.around_iff); a world is finite exactly where it is enumerated and identity among its relata is decided (World.finite_iff); dissipation is dissipation on every closed family read once per member (Flow.dissipative_iff); every census decides identity among what it lists (Listed.identityDecided), and any listing with identity decided gives a census (Listed.of_listing). Repetition is not harmless: in Doubled the flow balances and dissipates, the family listing twice the condition that comes to stand is closed and not dissipated on, and its stock does not fall, while listed once it falls (Doubled.needs_once). No premise. Read on a flow's steps, what takes part in a step can be listed once, and has a number, exactly where identity among it is decided (listsOnce_iff_decided, numbers_iff_decided); a step listing one relatum twice numbers one relatum in two places (Flow.present_repeated); and every flow on a type lists each step once exactly where identity on the type is decided (Flow.present_listsOnce_all_iff). The other 22 laws the inventory classed so are proved the same way in Becoming.ListingRefutations, with no Distinct (Flow.fed_from_beyond_listing, Web.embodiedArising_fed_from_beyond_listing, Flow.More.opens_listing, Web.embodiedArising_opens_listing, Flow.taking_draws_in_from_listing, Web.embodiedArising_draws_in_listing, Flow.rising_not_recurring_listing, Flow.taking_needs_refinement_listing, Flow.boundary_crossed_listing, Flow.region_not_a_cut_listing and the rest), being fed from beyond and the boundary of a region as a cut being matters of membership (Flow.FedFromBeyond.of_within, Flow.cut_of_same); the seven whose law's statement takes decided identity on its type ([DecidableEq]) keep it, the other fifteen need none.

hypotheses.zh: 不加前提：listsOnce_iff_decided、numbers_iff_decided、World.finite_iff、Flow.enclosed_iff、Flow.around_iff 与 Flow.dissipative_iff 是双向的，对每个列表、流与世界成立。
hypotheses.en: No premise: listsOnce_iff_decided, numbers_iff_decided, World.finite_iff, Flow.enclosed_iff, Flow.around_iff and Flow.dissipative_iff are two-way and hold for every list, flow and world.

hypotheses.zh: 已定（Decided）是 P58 的：一个命题成立或不成立已给出；不用排中律。
hypotheses.en: Decided is P58's: that a proposition holds or fails is given; excluded middle is not used.

hypotheses.zh: 没有修改任何已有模块：已有定义被证明等价于其重新奠基的形式。
hypotheses.en: No existing module is changed: the existing definitions are proved equivalent to their re-founded forms.

correspondence.zh: P77（工作板），按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“move towards 100%”：零前提计划把每个关系项列出一次、家族不重复（Distinct）列为表示的承诺（(b) 类第 4 项）。像 P58 对可判定性那样，这里找出这一承诺是什么：它就是在求和或计数之处其成员之间同一已定，一个局部条件。清点（inventory）：15 个模块中 169 个声明直接用到 Distinct；30 个不需要任何前提，33 个是按成员求和的局部条件，31 个是计数关系项的局部条件，9 个按出现重新奠基，其余是数、工具或见证。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用）：列出一次所承诺的不多于此。见整合文档 §101。
correspondence.en: P77 (work board), following Ren's “move towards 100%” of 12 October 2026: the zero-premise plan lists among the commitments of the representation that each relatum is listed once and families are without repetition (Distinct; class (b), item 4). As P58 did for decidedness, this finds what the commitment is: identity decided among the members where a sum or count is taken, a local condition. Inventory: 169 declarations in 15 modules use Distinct directly; 30 need no premise, 33 are local conditions of a sum once per member, 31 local conditions of a count of relata, 9 are re-founded by occurrence, and the rest are numbers, tools or witnesses. Reading (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): listing once commits to no more than this. See the integration document §101.

aliases: what takes part in a step, counted

detail.zh: 复用 P58 的 Decided 与普查：普查决定其所列者之间的同一，带同一判定的列出给出普查。
detail.en: Reuses P58's Decided and censuses: a census decides identity among what it lists, and a listing with identity decided gives a census.

detail.zh: 复用 Sampling 的 Once 与跨粗步的平衡：按出现读的流满足 Once，平衡于是在粗步上组合。
detail.en: Reuses Sampling's Once and balance across a coarse step: a flow read by occurrence satisfies Once, so balance composes across coarse steps.

output.zh: 跨粗步的平衡，在每个参与者列出一次时。
output.en: Balance across a coarse step, where each relatum taking part is listed once.

conditions.zh: Sampling 的并仍需 DecidableEq F。
conditions.en: Sampling's union still needs DecidableEq F.

detail.zh: 有限世界：这里证明它恰是可枚举加上关系项之间同一已定。
detail.en: Finite worlds: here proved to be exactly an enumeration with identity among the relata decided.

detail.zh: 停息定理（World.rests_unrefuted）：这里推广到每个可枚举的世界，不需列出一次。
detail.en: The rest theorem (World.rests_unrefuted): extended here to every enumerated world, with no listing once.

detail.zh: 耗散下复现的取用打开有限家族：这里对任何列出方式的家族成立。
detail.en: Under dissipation recurring taking opens finite families: here for families however listed.

detail.zh: 同一模块中同一的边界：经关系计数的关系项与按出现读。
detail.en: The boundary of identity in the same module: relata counted through relations, and reading by occurrence.

detail.zh: 把一个成员列两次的家族上求和之律不成立（Doubled.needs_once；Lone.repeated_family；Repeated）。
detail.en: A sum law fails over a family listing a member twice (Doubled.needs_once; Lone.repeated_family; Repeated).

detail.zh: 清点：每个 Distinct 用处的类别与地位。
detail.en: The inventory: the kind and status of every use of Distinct.

limitations.zh: 30 个不需前提的用处中，6 个在 Becoming.Listing、22 个在 Becoming.ListingRefutations 作为推论证明（其中规律陈述在类型上取 [DecidableEq] 的 7 个保留该实例，只去掉 Distinct），其余 2 个是见证内部、其列表按构造不重复的律；计数关系项不能不加前提；读法是 AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: Of the 30 uses needing no premise, 6 are proved as corollaries in Becoming.Listing and 22 in Becoming.ListingRefutations (the seven of these whose law's statement takes [DecidableEq] on its type keep that instance and drop Distinct only); the other 2 are laws inside witnesses whose lists are without repetition by construction; counting relata cannot be made free of a premise; the readings are the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; no ethical predicate occurs.

validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 85 theorems of Becoming.Listing all have empty axiom reports, among them IdentityDecided, ListsOnce, listsOnce_iff_decided, not_not_listsOnce, listOnce, Numbers, numbers_iff_decided, not_of_listsOnce, World.Enumerated, World.finite_iff, World.Enumerated.not_recurring, Flow.enclosed_iff, Flow.dissipative_iff and Doubled.needs_once. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).
